waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: f1-stale-answer-releases
mutations.why: F1 as it was: main judged the remembered answer of a bridge that did not answer in time, so a write the session started since was released to the peer while it ran.

mutations.name: f2-revert-to-committed-claim
mutations.why: F2 as it was: a retire that found the file being written left the running call's taken-over claim alone, so the call failing gave the committed claim back.
mutations.search: THEN {[c EXCEPT !.earlier = IF c.earlier = m.st THEN 0 ELSE c.earlier] : c \in calls}

mutations.name: f3-committed-key-without-load
mutations.why: F3 as it was: main's memory of committed claims ignored the omp load, so a restarted omp's restored claim (stamps numbered from 1 again) was retired for an earlier load's commit.
mutations.replace: ELSE IF \E e \in before : e[2] = k.st THEN "committed"

mutations.name: release-a-pending-claim
mutations.why: 323c8ed's class: main judges a claim git shows clean while a call is still writing it.

mutations.name: forget-committed-when-git-dirty
mutations.why: 12ef99a's class: a claim main judged committed is judged by git alone on the next pass, so a peer's later change of the file reads as this session's while the retire has not landed.

mutations.name: retire-ignores-stamp
mutations.why: ca16de6's class: the bridge drops a claim main saw committed although the session changed the file again since.

mutations.name: retire-ignores-load
mutations.why: A retire computed from an earlier omp load's stamps applies to the restored claims, whose stamps start at 1 again.

mutations.name: run-end-settles-every-agent
mutations.why: 089d329 as it was: a subagent's run end settled the main agent's running calls too.

mutations.name: confirm-keeps-stamp
mutations.why: A call that reports back no longer moves the stamp on, so a commit of the session's own that began before the call ended takes the call's landed write for committed.
mutations.search: Confirmed(s, q) == IF s # 0 THEN <<q + 1, q + 1>> ELSE <<s, q>>

mutations.name: retire-while-writing
mutations.why: The bridge drops a claim a running call is writing.
mutations.equivalent: Every running call holds the newest stamp of F, taken at its hook; a retire carries a stamp main read with no call pending, so a running call's stamp never equals it. The ledger's own check is a second line behind main's pending rule.

mutations.name: clean-drops-a-running-write
mutations.why: The advisory's path as it was: a commit by the session that succeeds drops F although a call that began earlier still writes it, and that call's confirm cannot bring the claim back, so its landed write is nobody's.
mutations.search: /\ stamp' = IF clean /\ ~writes THEN 0 ELSE stamp
mutations.replace: /\ stamp' = IF clean THEN 0 ELSE stamp

mutations.name: clean-keeps-taken-over-claim
mutations.why: A commit that made F clean leaves a running call's taken-over claim in place, so the call writing nothing gives the committed claim back.
mutations.search: /\ calls' = IF clean THEN {[x EXCEPT !.earlier = 0] : x \in others} ELSE others
